instruction: Cinematic film still, medium eye-level tracking shot. Outdoors next to a brick building with large windows, the man in the maroon zip-up hoodie (R2) with a yellow backpack walks on the left, listening attentively with a slight smile. On the right, the woman in the maroon puffer jacket (R1) with a white backpack walks beside him, gesturing with her left hand raised as she speaks animatedly. They walk side-by-side in soft natural daylight against the warm brick wall background, casting soft shadows.
